title: I made a "simple" army auto battler (+ how-to guide)
author: Appropriate-Lab3053
selftext:
Hobbyist. Made a "simple" army autobattler with html/CSS (me) and JavaScript (AI cause JS does not compute in my brain). I explain how below.

FEATURES

\- spend supplies to field an army to attack defenders

\- morale system, soldiers run away if morale is low

\- Tons of upgrades (including extremely rare, game breaking UNIQUE upgrades)

\- light and hard cover on the map. Both sides will stick to cover if they can

\- refund system for surviving forces, troops are NOT expendable 

\- different classes of units, with their own strengths/weaknesses 

HOW I MADE IT

Using Gemini flash, free tier. It made the game in about 30 seconds, but I spent a week manually fine tuning and adding new features.

1) Give Gemini a prompt of the languages, art style, and core mechanics.

2) To add new features, give Gemini the code and say "I want to add X to this game, it works like x, what code do I use and where do I add it?" and it'll give you the code and tell you where to put it.

3) Gemini flash isn't that great, so some coding knowledge is needed here as sometimes it "forgets" mechanics or functions and messes up the game if you blindly copy/paste in.

4) Once the game reaches 700+ lines, Gemini will really struggle. You must give it blocks of code and ask "How can I add X to this?"

5) this method has limits. I legit can't add much more to this game now. But it's great for "simple" games like this 😀

BIGGEST STRUGGLES

\- AI pathfinding is extremely difficult and still not perfect

\- projectile collisions are jank as heck, but they do work

It's on my website if you want to play (not sure if I can post the link here?)
